purpose: Make Heavyster feel calm, premium, and simple as the marketplace scales across countries, roles, suppliers, and AI-assisted workflows.
rule: Breathe first: show the role, the next move, and the proof before any secondary feature.
product_feel: Calm operating room, not crowded marketplace.
One active role and one useful next action.
Soft contrast, stable spacing, and clear decision receipts.
No AI noise and no country fork until the core workflow is proven.

role_lanes.success: Buyer sees the strongest machine, proof, availability, and direct supplier route first.
Supplier can manage listing, proof, freshness, revenue, and lead response without an admin maze.
Founder expands only where demand, supply gap, trust, and paid listing ARR are visible.

design_tokens.label: Contrast
design_tokens.detail: Quiet surfaces with strong readable text.

design_tokens.label: Spacing
design_tokens.detail: Enough distance between controls so the next action is easy to see.

design_tokens.label: Proof
design_tokens.detail: Trust, verification, and readiness use a calm proof color.

design_tokens.label: Revenue
design_tokens.detail: Listing money stays visible but never pushy.

design_tokens.label: AI
design_tokens.detail: AI appears only when it saves effort or clarifies the next action.

ai_rule: AI may draft, summarize, route, or explain only when it removes manual work or shortens a decision.
monetization_rule: Free supplier profile, USD 9/month or USD 99/year per active listing, 0% rental take in phase one, optional 1% confirmed-booking success fee only after workflow proof.
acceptance: Pricing shows the Serenity Mode panel below the Calm Command Center.
Build Phase shows the Serenity Mode contract before the Release Ledger.
Copy serenity brief explains buyer, supplier, founder, design, AI, and phase-one monetization rules.
Static checks enforce v137 version, cache tokens, UI hooks, docs, and styling.
